mapper.select: SELECT * FROM channel_prices WHERE variant_id = #{variantId} AND channel = #{channel}::sales_channel AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > NOW()) LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM channel_prices WHERE variant_id = #{variantId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > NOW()) ORDER BY channel
SELECT * FROM channel_prices WHERE variant_id = #{variantId} AND channel = #{channel}::sales_channel ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel_prices ( id, variant_id, channel, currency_code, amount_units, amount_nanos, status, effective_from, effective_to, created_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{variantId}, #{channel}::sales_channel, #{currencyCode}, #{amountUnits}, #{amountNanos}, #{status}::price_status, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{createdBy}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE channel_prices SET status = 'SUPERSEDED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE variant_id = #{variantId} AND channel = #{channel}::sales_channel AND status = 'ACTIVE'
